design_concept.vibe: Industrial, mechanical precision, measured to the millimeter, high-end construction.

headings.font_family: Clash Display, Cabinet Grotesk, Barlow, sans-serif

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl uppercase tracking-tighter text-zinc-950

layout.spacing_system: Generous scaling: p-6, p-8, p-12, py-24. Containers with borders MUST have internal p-6 or p-8 to prevent text collision.
layout.grids: Bento grids with asymmetry. Use Mode B 'Control Room' logic for services: tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6) with pure 1px borders.
layout.alignment: Left-align by default. Create tension via asymmetry. Avoid centering large blocks of text.
layout.surface_strategy: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Expose the skeleton. Use border-collapse style layouts for features. No soft shadows. 1px solid borders everywhere. Sharp corners (rounded-none or max rounded-sm).

motion.hover_states: Crisp, fast. transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out. Background shifts from transparent to very light grey, or border color shifts to metallic blue.

components.buttons: Square edges (rounded-none or rounded-sm). High contrast. Primary: bg-blue-700 text-white hover:bg-blue-800. Secondary: bg-transparent border border-zinc-300 text-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-100.
components.cards: Flat, 1px border (border-zinc-200). No drop shadow. Padding inside must be at least p-6.
components.forms: Shadcn components heavily customized: sharp edges, clear focus states (ring-blue-600), monochrome neutral borders.
components.navigation: Sticky, Glassmorphism with sharp 1px bottom border (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/90 border-b border-zinc-200). Must include CTA.

image_urls.description: Glass revolving doors with modern interior lighting - represents high-end commercial doors. Use with bg-black/60 overlay for text contrast.
Metal door with latch and lock - clean and secure.
Close-up of a locked metal door with industrial design.
Man standing in a cluttered workshop with machinery - perfect for 10+ years experience, mentor storytelling.
Old padlock securing a wooden door - use for the 'Before' or 'Problem' section.
A textured metallic surface with scratches - use for heavy footer or industrial CTA section background with dark overlay.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure APCA contrast ratios. Text over textures or hero images must have dark overlays (e.g., bg-black/60).
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, forms, links) MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure HTML + Tailwind for complex marketing layouts (Hero, About, Grids). Do not over-rely on Shadcn for layout structures.
Use Shadcn components ONLY for interactive elements (Forms, Inputs, Modals). Customize them to remove the default rounded corners; make them sharp (rounded-none or max rounded-sm).
Do NOT use center-alignment for text unless in a constrained column. Left-align is preferred for the industrial/precise look.
In the Hero Section, overlay the background image with bg-black/60 or a gradient to ensure text readability.
Implement the 'Grid Borders' look for services/problems: Use border-r, border-b on features to look like architectural blueprints. Make it feel measured and precise.
DO NOT use purple or teal gradients. Strictly adhere to the monochrome + metallic blue palette.
Install Phosphor Icons or Lucide for technical, precision-looking icons.
Ensure the navigation has a solid or blurred background; do not leave it fully transparent over scrolling content.
Follow the requested pages structure: Accueil, Services, À Propos, Contact.
